item.title: How a metabolite protects the enzyme that consumes it
item.description: Metabolites are consumed by enzymes to produce other vital molecules as well as to control metabolite levels. But how do cells avoid consuming too much? Researchers from the MPI of Biochemistry, with the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and the de Duve Institute in Brussels, have deciphered such molecular regulation in tryptophan metabolism. The essential amino acid tryptophan binds to a second site on the enzyme TDO2, distinct from where it is consumed. This sequesters a region needed by two effectors, the kinase CK2 and the ubiquitin ligase CUL1–β-TrCP, which act sequentially to signal TDO2… Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: For more than 60 years, visitors walked through a cave in Spain; now 280 motifs identified
item.description: A remarkable archaeological find at Cova de la Font Major has revealed 280 Palaeolithic engravings, showcasing diverse motifs of animals and geometric shapes. This challenges the previously held notion that cave art was scarce in northeastern Iberia, where only two pieces were known. These engravings suggest the existence of unique artistic traditions independent of the famous Franco-Cantabrian region, offering new insights into the cultural practices of Ice Age Europe. item.description: «El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin , no tiene derecho de veto en asuntos de seguridad europea y Ucrania debe integrarse plenamente en la arquitectura de seguridad europea », ha zanjado la jefa de política exterior de la UE, Kaja Kallas, en Varsovia, donde ha asistido a la cumbre ministerial del E5 que reunía al Consejo de Estados del Mar Báltico y Ucrania.«Ya tenemos una arquitectura de seguridad europea establecida. La OTAN y la Unión Europea tienen sus respectivos roles. item.title: US midterms mark 'the beginning of the end' for Trump, John Bolton says
item.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, John Bolton, who served as national security adviser to Donald Trump during his first term, called the US midterm results "the beginning of the end" for Trump's stranglehold on the Republican Party. Democrats regained control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate earlier this week, marking the Republicans' worst performance since the 1974 elections in the wake of the Watergate scandal. Fuente: France 24 - English.
